findings.text: In a gpu-metal binary run with HL_GPU=1 these two files decide receipt bytes: the hiding coset encoding of every regular commitment (`metal_commit_zk`, metal.rs:1099-1107, MODE_ZK at :997), the unsalted column leaves, the opened columns (`MetalCommit::columns`), the message half of every clear vector (`MetalCommit::fold_rows`), and the device sumcheck rounds with their Fiat-Shamir replay (`MetalRounds::masked_prove`, :2069-2118). Neither is a source pin (run_capture.rs OWN / SHARED lists; s24_tests.rs:584-593 records reasons for the CUDA exclusions but says nothing of Metal), while the M26 comment (run_capture.rs:306-315) says a Metal-built bundle is tied to its Metal sources through slot_ir*.rs / metal_slot.rs. Read here for the privacy-relevant paths, NO LEAK FOUND: the pads and salts are drawn on the host before the offer (pcs.rs:766-801); `metal_commit_zk` refuses q = 0 and n + q > nn (:975-979, :1103-1105); the pad half of every clear vector is computed on the host from the host pads (pcs.rs:960-976); leaves are salted on the host; the round messages are masked by zkp-core's CfsMasker on the real transcript and each device challenge must equal the host's (:2080-2092); HL_METAL_DUMP writes kernel SOURCE only (:1229-1232), which holds no table or coefficient value. Moreover, for a receipt that VERIFIES, the opened columns must satisfy rho_k^T col_j = Enc(v_k)[j] for FS-drawn rho and S after the root, so a device encoding that departed from Enc(D, host pads) at an opened column would be rejected with overwhelming probability: a verifying Metal receipt's hiding does not rest on these files. What remains: (a) the gate's pin argument is incomplete for Metal-made bundles (a DEV-PASS -> PASS on such a bundle would rest on unread code); (b) a non-verifying receipt written by a faulty device path is not covered by that argument. The D60 bundles were written with HL_GPU unset (privacy_gate/logs/write.cmd), so for them metal.rs only answers `enabled() == false`.
findings.recommendation: Pin src/gpu/metal.rs and src/gpu/metal_kernels.metal (pure addition to SHARED_SOURCE_FILES, with an s24 assertion), or record HL_GPU / gpu::label() in the capture manifest and have the gate refuse a Metal-made bundle until they are pinned and read. Not required for the D60 CPU-made bundles.
